arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW full-body visual-novel sprite from scratch of Hu Tao from Genshin Impact expressing love-1. Input images: Image 1 is the explicitly approved neutral-v008, the PRIMARY guide for her exact cute petite proportions, balanced torso/legs, gently full thighs, very pale complexion and continuity across this set. Image 2 is the user's in-game model, authoritative for exact costume construction, accessory placement, hair and character eye design. Image 3 is the user's latest portrait artwork, guiding confident linework, soft painterly anime rendering and rounded facial features. Combine all three; preserve v008's build and use the model for outfit detail even where the portrait stylizes it. Do not copy the model's blue environmental lighting or the portrait's warm backdrop, border, hands or pose. Use neutral illumination and the approved neutral's very fair skin. Preserve its exact recognizable identity, face, pale skin, hair, eye colors, costume construction and detailed painterly anime illustration style, linework and shading. Preserve her long dark-brown hair with reddish tips, fringe and face-framing locks; exact dark hat with cream emblem, red plum blossom branch and tassel; red mandarin collar, patterned brown coat with large cuffs, dark shorts, gold closures and waist ornaments, hanging tassels, embroidered long coat tails, rings and dark nails, socks with red bands and blossoms, and decorated dark shoes.
Build and skin: match the approved neutral's cute petite Medium Female proportions, compact upper frame, balanced torso-to-leg ratio and gently full thighs. Do not stretch the torso or legs or turn her into a chibi. Keep the head, hat and oversized cuffs consistent with that approved build. Preserve her VERY FAIR PALE IVORY complexion with a delicate neutral/cool-pink undertone consistently on the face, neck, hands and legs. Use pale pink and cool neutral skin shading and neutral illumination without a yellow, orange, brown or tanned cast. Any emotion-specific cheek blush stays localized. Preserve the source's painted volume without bleaching away detail.
Personality and acting: Hu Tao is a mischievous poet and confident funeral-parlor director: quick-witted, cheeky, creatively theatrical and playful, with sincere compassion and professional dignity beneath her teasing. Give this emotion a Hu Tao-specific performance, using expressive brows, a playful rhythm to the pose when appropriate, and quiet sincerity for vulnerable emotions. Do not make sorrow or care into a joke. An openly joyful affectionate smile with gently parted lips, raised brows and both eyes visibly open, with a gentle rosy blush. Angle her shoulders toward the viewer and let the right hand hover near her heart while the left forearm opens softly down beside her waist. Give her a bright, warmly delighted posture and a buoyant head tilt, distinct from the quieter ordinary love pose. Vary her whole pose, head angle, torso stance and gesture as appropriate to the emotion rather than changing only the face or mechanically copying the neutral.
Heart-pupil design — essential: BOTH eyes visibly open, with natural coherent eyelids and the original complete reddish-amber irises, iris outlines, shading and visible colored iris borders. Inside EACH iris place ONE LARGE SOLID PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) HEART-SHAPED PUPIL. Two white heart pupils total, one in each eye. Each filled heart has two rounded upper lobes, a distinct central notch and a single pointed bottom, matching in size and design. Make the pupils clearly white, with no pink, rose, red or cream tint. Keep catchlights distinct from the heart shapes. The white hearts are the pupils, not highlights, whole-eye replacements, floating symbols or decorative overlays. For these two variants the normal blossom pupils are replaced completely by the white hearts; retain the original iris around them.
Hands and anatomy: use natural, softly articulated human hands, each with a believable palm, four gently curved fingers and a distinct opposable thumb. Let overlap follow the gesture rather than forcing hidden digits into view. Keep gestures simple and readable near the image plane, hands spatially separate, with clean contours and a small clear gap from adjacent fabric wherever they do not intentionally touch. Avoid reaching toward the camera, extreme foreshortening, tangled fingers and elaborate splaying. Exactly two coherent legs and feet, uncrossed in a balanced stance. Hair and heavy coat tails follow the pose naturally with gravity, and patterns and accessories turn with their actual surfaces. Preserve the complete outfit throughout.
Complete silhouette including hat branch and blossoms, hair tips, hands, sleeves, coat tails, tassels, socks and both shoes, with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding and 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background with clear alpha outside the character. Both hands empty. No scenery, backdrop, floor, reflection, ground shadow, detached floating flames, ghosts, particles, weapons, new props, text, labels, UI, watermark or additional characters. Produce one character sprite.
